agent_explanation: No pushes and tiny controller forces (~0.5N vs 44N limit), pole stays upright (margin ~0.72). Controller regulates angle/rate but leaves steady cart drift: starting from x=-0.24 with omega=-0.22, cart velocity goes increasingly negative (-0.24 at step50, -0.40 at step100, -1.09 at step200) and position integrates monotonically off the track at step223. Recentering initial x to 0 removes the failure.
